booking_fx_all_or_none_chk.name: booking_fx_all_or_none_chk
booking_fx_all_or_none_chk.value:
("booking"."original_amount_cents" IS NULL) = ("booking"."original_currency" IS NULL)
        AND ("booking"."original_currency" IS NULL) = ("booking"."fx_rate_micro" IS NULL)
        AND ("booking"."fx_rate_micro" IS NULL) = ("booking"."fx_fee_cents" IS NULL)

booking_fx_values_chk.name: booking_fx_values_chk
booking_fx_values_chk.value:
"booking"."original_amount_cents" IS NULL OR (
        "booking"."fx_rate_micro" > 0
        AND "booking"."original_currency" <> "booking"."currency"
        AND ("booking"."original_amount_cents" > 0) = ("booking"."amount_cents" > 0)
        AND ("booking"."original_amount_cents" < 0) = ("booking"."amount_cents" < 0))

split_income_type_chk.name: split_income_type_chk
split_income_type_chk.value: "booking_split"."income_type_id" IS NULL OR ("booking_split"."contact_id" IS NULL AND "booking_split"."transfer_id" IS NULL)

occurrence_booking_uq.name: occurrence_booking_uq
occurrence_booking_uq.where: "expected_occurrence"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "expected_occurrence"."deleted_at" IS NULL

trade_units_chk.name: trade_units_chk
trade_units_chk.value:
CASE
        WHEN "trade"."kind" IN ('buy', 'delivery_in') THEN "trade"."units_e8" > 0
        WHEN "trade"."kind" IN ('sell', 'delivery_out') THEN "trade"."units_e8" < 0
        WHEN "trade"."kind" = 'split' THEN "trade"."units_e8" <> 0
        ELSE "trade"."units_e8" = 0 END
